Lucas Degeorge

PhD Student working on Generative Modeling

I am a PhD student in Computer Vision at VISTA (Ecole polytechnique) and IMAGINE (Ecole des Ponts) labs, under the supervision of Vicky Kalogeiton and David Picard.

My research focuses on generative models for images, especially text-to-image generation and flow matching. I am interested in making these models more data- and compute-efficient and training competitive text-to-image models. I am also interested in vision representation learning.
